decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch still listed in 2024, this system shows enough continuing commitment and strategic fit with the firm's spraying equipment business that management would likely continue rather than admit a failed launch.

Its own webpage in both years and the reference to field testing indicate visible investment and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely despite any slow ramp-up.

Because it remains listed and explicitly builds on proven existing WIWA air motors, management can justify staying the course while attributing any weak sales to normal market adoption rather than product failure.

A dedicated product page in both 2023 and 2024 signals a clear public commitment, so a medium-sized German machinery firm would be inclined to retain it unless performance were clearly disastrous, which is not shown here.

Although only newly launched in 2024 and less prominently presented, it is very recent and close to the firm's core spraying technology, so management would likely give it more time before considering a withdrawal.
